action: Call Nicole Washington directly — not a follow-up email, a call. She said she wanted to talk and I am making that happen. The conversation has one objective: turn her stated interest into a signed pilot retainer. I come prepared with a specific, low-friction proposal — $300/month for a 3-month communications support pilot covering her personal brand and professional social presence as a nurse and community figure. Small enough that her budget concern does not kill it. Concrete enough that she cannot defer it. I ask directly: 'Based on what we talked about, I want to propose a three-month pilot starting this month. Can we do that?' If yes, I send a one-page agreement within 24 hours. If no, I ask what would make it a yes and I listen.
